item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 6-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 6 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it 2 seconds shorter and keep everything else the same.

dialog.agent:
I can use your portrait with a friendly, non-cloned female English voice and no captions, but Magic Hour’s free plan limits text-scripted talking videos to **5 seconds**. Your exact script needs the requested 8 seconds to sound natural.

To keep the full script and 8-second square format, you’ll need a credit pack or paid plan. I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the free-settings generation because your account has **insufficient credits**. No video was created.

You’ll need to replenish your credits before I can generate it.

She looks at the camera with a warm friendly expression, subtle natural movements and accurate lip sync. Speak exactly this complete dialogue, briskly but clearly so all words fit within five seconds: "Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new." No other speech. No captions, subtitles, text overlays, logos or music.
